task_instance: Run ethos-explore on a small realistic agent codebase (an internal VPN/password/software-access IT helpdesk agent with agent.yaml, a system prompt, two @tool definitions, README/design docs, and an eval script) to capture its intended behavior and produce the confirmed intent draft that gets handed to ethos-write.
blocker_detail: The skill is explicitly dialogue-driven: its core deliverable is a confirmed intent interview (not just an inferred draft). Step 2 is a declared HARD GATE that forbids presenting the full draft or handing off to ethos-write until at least three intent questions (Purpose & Outcomes, Principles, Vision) have each received a user reply in the conversation. The runtime states no user will answer in this session, so the mandatory interview cannot receive replies and the deliverable cannot be completed. The offline, read-only portion (pre-flight check for an existing ethos.md, codebase/doc scan, and mapping inferences to schema fields) ran fine, but the skill repeatedly marks producing the draft from the scan alone, without user replies, as a red-flag failure rather than an acceptable output.
evidence: Built a sample agent under <work>/sample_agent (README.md, vpn_helpdesk_agent/agent.yaml, prompts/system.txt, tools.py with two @tool fns, app.py using create_react_agent, docs/design.md, evals/run_evals.py). Ran the skill's pre-flight: find -maxdepth 4 -iname ethos.md => 'no ethos.md yet'. Ran Step 1 scan: find for agent.yaml => vpn_helpdesk_agent/agent.yaml; grep for create_react_agent/system_prompt/@tool => matched harness import, agent.yaml prompt ref, two @tool decorators; grep TODO => app.py 'add latency logging before prod'. From this I could infer implementation-shaped fields (name, Tools=kb_search/reset_password, Harness=react loop, Behavior from system prompt, Evaluation Setup from evals/run_evals.py with 0.85 threshold, Open Questions from the TODO). The scan step is fully achievable offline. The intent fields the skill mandates confirming from the user (Purpose & Outcomes, Principles, Vision, plus Constraints/Trade-offs/ranked Success Criteria) require interactive replies that the hard gate will not let me bypass; no user is present to supply them, so no confirmed intent draft / ethos-write handoff could be produced or verified.
